answer.sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(hours_to_close) AS avg_hours_to_close,
    total_value
FROM 
    svc311
JOIN 
    property_homes ON svc311.zipcode = property_homes.zipcode
WHERE 
    svc311.zipcode IN ('02119', '02130')
GROUP BY 
    total_value
ORDER BY 
    total_value
LIMIT 200
